total_request_timeout_secs.description: The total length of time (in seconds) to wait for a signing request to complete.

sigul_request_timeout_secs.description: The timeout (in seconds) to wait for a response from the Sigul server.

sigul_bridge_hostname.description: The hostname of the Sigul bridge; this is used to verify the bridge's TLS certificate.

sigul_bridge_port.description: The port to connect to the Sigul bridge; the typical port is 44334.

sigul_server_hostname.description: The hostname of the Sigul server; this is used to verify the server's TLS certificate.

sigul_user_name.description: The username to use when authenticating with the Sigul bridge.

sigul_private_key.description: The systemd credentials ID of the PEM-encoded private key file.

sigul_client_certificate.description: The path to client certificate that matches the private_key.

sigul_ca_certificate.description: The path to the certificate authority to use when verifying the Sigul bridge and Sigul server certificates.

keys.description: A list of signing keys available for use.
